answer: Random peer audit: each epoch a beacon names 200 auditors, each audits one random peer. The auditor stakes 50 POA and checks the peer's work log; a karst cave of fakes leaves hollow records that collapse. A ring of 100 fakes pays 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, and with a 1-in-5 audit chance each risks its deposit plus a 200 POA fine, so losses pass 9,000 POA against 2,000 POA of rewards. An honest agent stakes once and keeps the nectar of its earnings.
